items.title: ESP32 firmware runs in your browser
items.oneliner: Browser emulator boots real ESP32 images with ROM and bootloader support, so you can test firmware without hardware.

items.title: Run GGUF models on PS5
items.oneliner: Jailbroken PS5 app runs llama.cpp models locally with Vulkan, OpenAI-compatible APIs, and 11.4 GB shared memory.

items.title: Distill a reasoning model yourself
items.oneliner: Hands-on video walks through teacher-student distillation, dataset prep, loss setup, and training loops for smaller reasoning models.

items.title: Understand PyTorch memory budget optimization
items.oneliner: Deep dive explains PyTorch's new knapsack-based memory planner that cuts peak RAM by up to 20x.

items.title: Use OpenRewrite recipes correctly
items.oneliner: Reference page maps current OpenRewrite modules, BOM usage, and recipe coordinates for large-scale automated code migrations.

items.title: Build deterministic concurrent systems
items.oneliner: Open source reactor framework targets C, Python, Rust, and TypeScript for race-free concurrent and distributed applications.

items.title: Deploy DeepSeek Flash multimodal weights
items.oneliner: Downloadable Hugging Face model includes Transformers, Colab, and Docker paths for running the latest DeepSeek Flash.

items.title: Compare local LLM hardware speed
items.oneliner: Interactive benchmark explorer estimates tokens per second across CPUs, GPUs, and models before you buy local inference hardware.

items.title: Map benchmarks to real work
items.oneliner: Benchmark map shows which occupations current AI evals actually cover, helping teams choose metrics closer to production tasks.

items.title: Learn Monte Carlo by coding
items.oneliner: Clear tutorial builds Monte Carlo estimators for pi, integration, and combinatorics with implementation details you can reuse.
